name: Price Extreme Strategy
summary: Price Extreme Strategy is an Expert Advisor that identifies extreme price levels (highest highs and lowest lows) over a defined period and enters breakout trades when price breaches these extremes. It aims to capture strong directional moves following the breakout of established price boundaries. The EA systematically places buy orders on upside breakouts and sell orders on downside breakouts with predefined risk management parameters.
summary_zh: 价格极值策略EA通过识别设定周期内的极端价格水平（最高点和最低点），在价格突破这些极值时入场交易。该策略旨在捕捉价格突破既有边界后的强势方向性走势。EA在向上突破时系统性地下买入单，在向下突破时下卖出单，并配置了预定义的风险管理参数。
strategy_analysis: 该策略的核心概念是基于价格极值突破，即在一定周期内识别价格的最高点和最低点作为关键支撑阻力位。入场条件为：当价格突破N周期内的最高价时开多单，当价格跌破N周期内的最低价时开空单，属于典型的突破策略。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损，以及在极值重新计算时平仓。仓位管理方面，该EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位。资金管理方面，通过止损控制单笔风险，但需关注连续假突破带来的回撤风险。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中容易因频繁假突破而亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this strategy is based on price extreme breakouts, identifying the highest and lowest prices over a defined period as key support and resistance levels. Entry conditions: a buy order is placed when price breaks above the N-period high, and a sell order is placed when price breaks below the N-period low, representing a classic breakout approach. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, with position closure when price extremes are recalculated. Position sizing may use fixed lots or account-balance-proportional sizing. Money management relies on stop-losses to control per-trade risk, but the strategy is vulnerable to drawdowns from consecutive false breakouts. The strategy performs well in trending markets but suffers in ranging markets due to frequent false breakout whipsaws.

parameters.name: ExtremePeriod
parameters.description: 计算价格极值的回溯周期
parameters.description_en: Lookback period for price extreme calculation

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Order magic number to manage; 0 manages all orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简洁，基于价格极值突破具有统计学上的可靠性
自带止损止盈设置，风险可控，单笔亏损有上限
在趋势明确的市场中表现优异，能捕捉大幅单边行情
参数化设计便于优化和适应不同品种周期
pros_en: Clear and concise strategy logic with statistical reliability based on price extreme breakouts
Built-in stop-loss and take-profit settings provide controlled risk with capped per-trade loss
Performs excellently in trending markets, capable of capturing large directional moves
Parameterized design allows optimization and adaptation to different instruments and timeframes
cons: 在震荡市中容易产生频繁假突破信号，导致连续亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤器，无法区分趋势和震荡行情
固定止损可能在波动率变化时不适应当前市场条件
缺少仓位加码机制，无法在趋势确认后增加敞口
cons_en: Prone to frequent false breakout signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Lacks a market regime filter to distinguish trending from ranging conditions
Fixed stop-loss may not adapt to changing market volatility conditions
No position scaling mechanism to increase exposure after trend confirmation
improvements: 增加ATR自适应止损止盈，根据市场波动率动态调整风险参数
添加趋势过滤器（如ADX或均线方向），在震荡市中减少无效交易
improvements_en: Add ATR-adaptive stop-loss and take-profit to dynamically adjust risk parameters based on market volatility
Add a trend filter (such as ADX or moving average direction) to reduce ineffective trades in ranging markets

risk_points: 震荡市中假突破频繁导致连续止损
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，低波动时止损过大高波动时止损过小
无最大回撤限制或日内亏损限制机制
risk_points_en: Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets lead to consecutive stop-loss hits
Fixed stop-loss doesn't account for volatility changes — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
No maximum drawdown limit or daily loss cap mechanism

The EA systematically places buy orders on upside breakouts and sell orders on downside breakouts with predefined risk management parameters.
